content.short: Alchemy Ventures provides web3 investment fund dedicated to teams building revolutionary blockchain products.
content.description: With the goal of bringing blockchain to a billion people, the parent company Alchemy introduced an investment firm called Alchemy Ventures. Alchemy Ventures is a VC fund empowering developers and communities that are building financial services, DeFi, and more onchain.
